ellie (docs): I opened a slim PR to add nebula-3b to the model catalog: hardware notes, a compact bench table, runtime compat, and a quick migration snippet for teams pinned to older models. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infer-docs/pull/509

ryan (eng): skimmed. Please include A100/A10/T4 rows and batch=8. My rough perf: A100 34 r/s @512, A10 18 r/s, T4 9 r/s. Add p95 token latency too (A100 ~80ms, T4 ~230ms).

mina (ml): Add quant guidance: default=ptq4, int8-experimental with known rotary regressions. Note runtime ABI >=2.4.0; older runtimes require conversion. Also mention sequence ceiling=16k, practical quality drop after ~12k.

ellie (docs): drafting migration CLI and SDK snippets. CLI alias example and minimal Python streaming example included. Will fix two broken image links found earlier.

tom (product): include a short canary YAML (10% traffic) and a migration paragraph explaining alias vs pin (pin freezes a model version). Also QA asked for a small synthetic 12k-token smoke test to catch truncation.

ci-bot: PR updated by ellie — added bench table, compatibility notes, migration examples, canary config, and smoke test snippet.

ryan (eng): ACK. I'll paste CSV perf later.

mina (ml): ML compat OK.

ellie (docs): merging in 15m if no objections. :thumbsup:
